title: Hazelnut Crumbly Argentinian Meat Empanadas
description: These sweet, crumbly empanadas are a twist on traditional Argentinian meat empanadas, featuring hazelnuts and a low-sodium friendly filling.
instructions: In a large pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped green pepper and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the hazelnuts, flour, salt, black pepper, and bhuna spice mix, and stir to combine.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 3mm.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a spoonful of the meat filling in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of water and sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
